title: Who really gets the credit card rewards #shorts
description:
People who carry a balance pay 94% of card interest and fees but earn 27% of the rewards; people who pay in full pay 6% and earn 73% (FACT): CFPB, The Consumer Credit Card Market, 2023, data for 2022.
